jsDoc.doc:
Supported format for front matter. `"unknown"` is used when auto format
detection logic fails.

Tests if a string has valid front matter.
Supports {@link https://yaml.org | YAML}, {@link https://toml.io | TOML} and
{@link https://www.json.org/ | JSON}.

tags.name: str
tags.doc: String to test.

tags.name: formats
tags.doc: A list of formats to test for. Defaults to all supported formats.
`true` if the string has valid front matter, otherwise `false`.

jsDoc.doc:
Extracts and parses {@link https://yaml.org | YAML}, {@link https://toml.io |
TOML}, or {@link https://www.json.org/ | JSON} from the metadata of front
matter content, depending on the format.

tags.name: T
tags.doc: The type of the parsed front matter.

tags.name: text
tags.doc: The text to extract front matter from.
The extracted front matter and body content.

jsDoc.doc:
Extracts and parses {@link https://www.json.org/ | JSON } from the metadata
of front matter content.

tags.name: T
tags.doc: The type of the parsed front matter.

tags.name: text
tags.doc: The text to extract JSON front matter from.
The extracted JSON front matter and body content.
